metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code mods, shipped as plugins

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Shows the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one colour per /context category; /context-bar toggles it

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Blocks destructive shell commands and access to secret files before they run, anywhere in a compound command

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Native desktop notifications that say what happened: a long turn finished (with its answer), a permission prompt or a question waiting for you

plugins.name: redact
plugins.description: Keeps secrets that tools print (keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) out of what the model reads and the next request sends

plugins.name: turn-stats
plugins.description: Adds what a turn did to its 'Worked for' line: tool calls by tool, failures, files changed and cost
